editorial_scope: Methods of measuring beer color, bitterness, extract, acidity and sensory change; historical context and transfer limits. All texts are AI-researched drafts.

sources.title: A Hands-On Guide to Brewing and Analyzing Beer in the Laboratory (2019)
sources.access_scope: Full paper indexed through PubMed Central search output including named laboratory methods; direct open intermittently presented a browser check. Published lab protocols, not validated consumer operations.

sources.title: BJCP Color Guide: Technical Background
sources.access_scope: Full public technical guide: 430-nm absorbance, SRM/EBC relationship and visual guide limits; not a production quality certificate.

sources.title: Beer 23: Bitterness Units (BU), Manual Isooctane Extraction
sources.access_scope: Full public method summary of solvent extraction and 275-nm absorbance; proprietary/full method not independently reviewed. Hazardous chemicals are not an at-home procedure.

sources.title: Changes in beer bitterness level during the beer production process (2023)
sources.access_scope: Open full research review of hop acid transformations, humulinones, polyphenols and limits of spectrophotometric IBU; not new measured sensory preference data.

sources.title: Evaluation of Components Contributing to the International Bitterness Unit of Wort and Beer (2022)
sources.author_label: Journal of the American Society of Brewing Chemists research authors
sources.access_scope: Publisher indexed abstract with studied beers having similar BU but unlike iso-alpha acid profiles; full article was not accessible during this research.

sources.title: Beer 9: pH (Hydrogen Ion Concentration), Master the Method
sources.access_scope: Public ASBC meter-calibration and sample-measurement explanation; not a laboratory accreditation or drinking-water safety method.

sources.title: Beer 8: Total Acidity as Titratable Acidity, Master the Method
sources.access_scope: Public titration/end-point explanation and method limitations; not a test for foodborne pathogens or identification of all individual acids.

sources.title: ISO 4120:2021 Sensory analysis — Methodology — Triangle test
sources.access_scope: Official scope and dated publication; ISO confirmed this edition in 2026. Full paywalled normative text was not accessed; no claim to reproduce its complete method.

sources.title: ISO 8589:2007 Sensory analysis — General guidance for the design of test rooms
sources.access_scope: Official abstract and 2026 confirmation of room-design guidance; full standard and 2014 amendment not read.

sources.title: Beer Evaluation and the Judging Process
sources.access_scope: Public tasting and context guide, originally tied to older examination material; practical judging advice is not controlled consumer research.

sources.title: How sensory and hedonic expectations shape perceived properties of regular and non-alcoholic beer (2022)
sources.author_label: Helena Blackmore, Claire Hidrio and Martin R. Yeomans
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract and highlights of experimental expectancy effects; full sample methods and all subgroup estimates not examined.

sources.title: John Richardson, saccharometry and the pounds-per-barrel extract: the construction of a quantity (2001)
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract of a historiographical article on Richardson's brewing extract quantity; paywalled body and archival notes not inspected.

sources.title: Improved saccharometer, object 1954-382
sources.access_scope: Full museum object metadata identifies Dring and Fage, circa 1830, components and dimensions; photographs and full rights-controlled media not reproduced.

sources.title: Tables and directions for using the saccharometer (1784)
sources.access_scope: Public collection bibliographic entry dates the print to 1784; the listed source text is not treated as read in full.

sources.title: ISO 5492:2008 Sensory analysis — Vocabulary
sources.access_scope: Official 2008 standard scope, 2016 amendment notice and 2024 confirmation; 107-page vocabulary not accessed.

sources.title: Malt and Adjuncts: Color
sources.access_scope: Public BJCP study guide summarizes malt contributions to color and wort processing; educational rather than a universal formula.

sources.title: ASBC Laboratory Proficiency Program: Recommended Methods
sources.access_scope: Public list maps beer analytes to method families, not a claim that any particular brewery laboratory passed proficiency testing.

sources.title: NA Beer / Low Alcohol Beer / 0.0 Beer Methods
sources.access_scope: Public matrix of method applicability to low-/no-alcohol beer; full testing data and methods are not reproduced.

sources.title: Beer Methods Series
sources.author_label: American Society of Brewing Chemists and Brewers Association
sources.access_scope: Public method-demonstration index for gravity, apparent extract, acidity, pH and degassing; full member-only procedural text not claimed.
